test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Living within our environmental limits is one of the central ______________ of sustainable development.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Principles**" refer to fundamental truths or propositions that serve as the foundation for a system of belief, behavior, or reasoning.
 
• In the context of sustainable development, principles are the core ideas or guidelines that drive and shape the concept.
 
• The other options (agencies, demonstrates, illuminates) do not fit the context of what central aspects of sustainable development would be called.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agencies:** Refers to organizations or entities that take actions, which is not suitable in this context.
 
• **Demonstrates:** Is a verb meaning to show or explain, which does not fit the noun required in this sentence.
 
• **Illuminates:** Is a verb meaning to light up or clarify, which also does not fit the noun required in this sentence.
